title: Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.27443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for cheap, high-throughput agentic deployment, but they remain weak at multi-step reasoning and tool use that long-horizon tasks demand. We study how to post-train an SLM to seek advice from a stronger model and act on that advice itself, following an advisor-executor pattern. Out of the box, this pattern fails across open- and closed-source small-model families: wiring an SLM to an advisor is a harness-design matter that is not enough on its own. A post-training recipe is needed to teach the model when to ask, in a cost-aware fashion, and how to follow advice across steps. Our method, ADAPT (ADvisor-Aware Post-Training), is a multi-stage recipe that instills this behavior, learning entirely from the policy's own rollouts supervised by the environment's outcome, with no learned reward model or human annotation. translated_title: 学习何时求助：面向小型语言模型智能体的顾问感知后训练
translated_abstract: 小型语言模型（SLM）因其低成本、高吞吐量的特点，在智能体部署中越来越具有吸引力，但它们在长程任务所需的多步推理和工具使用方面仍然薄弱。我们研究如何对SLM进行后训练，使其能够向更强的模型寻求建议并自己执行这些建议，即遵循“顾问-执行者”模式。然而开箱即用时，这种模式在开源和闭源的各种小模型家族中均告失败：仅仅将SLM连接到顾问上只是一个框架设计问题，本身并不足够。需要一种后训练方案来教会模型以成本感知的方式判断何时提问，以及如何跨步骤遵循建议。我们的方法ADAPT（ADvisor-Aware Post-Training，顾问感知后训练）是一种多阶段训练方案，能够培养这种行为，它完全从策略自身生成的rollouts中学习，并由环境的最终结果进行监督，无需学习奖励模型或人工标注。在三个领域中，与未训练的框架基线相比，ADAPT……
tldr: 提出ADAPT多阶段后训练方法，让小型语言模型智能体学会在成本感知下判断何时向更强模型求助并跨步骤遵循建议，且完全依靠环境结果监督的策略自身rollouts进行学习，无需奖励模型或人工标注。
en_tdlr: ADAPT is a multi-stage post-training recipe that teaches SLM agents when to cost-awarely seek advice from a stronger model and how to follow it across steps, learning entirely from the policy's own rollouts supervised by environment outcomes without any reward model or human annotation.
